questions.q: Which line correctly stores a height of 1.65 m?
questions.qAf: Watter reël stoor 'n lengte van 1,65 m korrek?

questions.q: Which is a valid variable name?
questions.qAf: Watter een is 'n geldige veranderlikenaam?
questions.explain: No starting number, no spaces, no reserved words; _ is allowed.
questions.explainAf: Geen getal aan die begin, geen spasies, geen gereserveerde woorde nie; _ word toegelaat.

questions.q: Which tag gives the largest heading?
questions.qAf: Watter etiket gee die grootste opskrif?

questions.q: Which opening tag gives a bulleted list with square bullets?
questions.qAf: Watter openingsetiket gee 'n kolpuntlys met vierkantige kolpunte?
questions.explain: <ul> with type square, circle or disc.
questions.explainAf: <ul> met type square, circle of disc.

questions.q: In h1 { color: blue; }, what is h1?
questions.qAf: Wat is h1 in h1 { color: blue; }?

questions.q: Cells A1 to A5 hold: Apple, 10, 20, (empty), 30. What does =AVERAGE(A1:A5) give?
questions.qAf: Selle A1 tot A5 bevat: Appel, 10, 20, (leeg), 30. Wat gee =AVERAGE(A1:A5)?

questions.q: What is the next number in 1, 2, 4, 7, 11, …?
questions.qAf: Wat is die volgende getal in 1, 2, 4, 7, 11, …?

questions.q: How many degrees of freedom does a circle have?
questions.qAf: Hoeveel vryheidsgrade het 'n sirkel?

questions.q: What does a constraint do?
questions.qAf: Wat doen 'n beperking?
options: Removes a DOF and fixes a size, position or angle
optionsAf: Verwyder 'n DOF en maak 'n grootte, posisie of hoek vas

questions.q: What are the two states of a digital pin?
questions.qAf: Wat is die twee toestande van 'n digitale pen?

questions.q: Which values does analog output accept, e.g. for LED brightness?
questions.qAf: Watter waardes aanvaar analoë uitset, bv. vir LED-helderheid?

questions.q: Which is an analog input?
questions.qAf: Watter een is 'n analoë inset?
questions.explain: Sensors with a range of values are analog.
questions.explainAf: Sensors met 'n reeks waardes is analoog.

questions.q: What can an analog output do with an LED that a digital output cannot?
questions.qAf: Wat kan 'n analoë uitset met 'n LED doen wat 'n digitale uitset nie kan nie?
questions.explain: Digital is only fully on or off.
questions.explainAf: Digitaal is net heeltemal aan of af.

sections.title: True or false
sections.intro: Decide whether each statement is true or false.
sections.introAf: Besluit of elke stelling waar of onwaar is.

questions.q: Java is case sensitive: Public and public are not the same.
questions.qAf: Java is hooflettersensitief: Public en public is nie dieselfde nie.
questions.explain: The keyword is public, with a small p.
questions.explainAf: Die sleutelwoord is public, met 'n kleinletter p.

questions.q: The alt text shows if the image fails to load.
questions.qAf: Die alt-teks wys as die prent nie laai nie.

questions.q: Construction lines become part of the final 3D model.
questions.qAf: Konstruksielyne word deel van die finale 3D-model.

questions.q: A voltmeter is connected in parallel and an ammeter in series.
questions.qAf: 'n Voltmeter word in parallel gekoppel en 'n ammeter in serie.
questions.explain: A voltmeter measures across a component; an ammeter measures the current through it.
questions.explainAf: 'n Voltmeter meet oor 'n komponent; 'n ammeter meet die stroom daardeur.

sections.title: Matching
sections.intro: Match column A to column B, and find the matching pairs.
sections.introAf: Pas kolom A by kolom B, en vind die pare wat bymekaar pas.

questions.q: Match each chart in column A with what it is best for in column B.
questions.qAf: Pas elke grafiek in kolom A by waarvoor dit die beste is in kolom B.
pairs: Parts of a whole, e.g. pass vs fail
Comparing categories, e.g. learners' test results
pairsAf: Dele van 'n geheel, bv. slaag teenoor druip
Om kategorieë te vergelyk, bv. leerders se toetsuitslae
questions.explain: Pie: parts of a whole. Bar/column: compare categories. Line: trends over time.
questions.explainAf: Sirkel: dele van 'n geheel. Staaf/kolom: vergelyk kategorieë. Lyn: neigings oor tyd.

questions.q: Find the matching pairs: link each pillar of computational thinking to an example of it.
questions.qAf: Vind die pare wat bymekaar pas: koppel elke pilaar van berekeningsdenke aan 'n voorbeeld daarvan.
pairs: Splitting a school fun day into food, games and tickets
A weather forecast based on trends
A map that shows only roads and landmarks
Precise steps for a robot to make a sandwich
pairsAf: Om 'n skoolpretdag in kos, speletjies en kaartjies op te deel
'n Kaart wat net paaie en landmerke wys
Presiese stappe vir 'n robot om 'n toebroodjie te maak
questions.explain: Decomposition splits the problem, pattern recognition predicts from repeats, abstraction leaves out detail, and an algorithm is a precise set of steps.
questions.explainAf: Ontbinding verdeel die probleem, patroonherkenning voorspel uit herhalings, abstraksie laat besonderhede uit, en 'n algoritme is 'n presiese stel stappe.

questions.q: Making a sandwich: match each part in column A with its place in the IPO model in column B.
questions.qAf: 'n Toebroodjie maak: pas elke deel in kolom A by sy plek in die IPO-model in kolom B.
pairsAf: Smeer, voeg by, maak toe en sny
questions.explain: IPO sorts a task into Input (what is needed), Process (the work done) and Output (the result).
questions.explainAf: IPO sorteer 'n taak in Inset (wat nodig is), Verwerking (die werk wat gedoen word) en Uitset (die resultaat).

questions.q: Match each sketch state in column A with its description in column B.
questions.qAf: Pas elke sketstoestand in kolom A by sy beskrywing in kolom B.
pairs: Zero DOF left; the sketch turns green
It still has degrees of freedom and can move
Too many constraints that conflict; it shows orange
pairsAf: Nul DOF oor; die skets word groen
Dit het nog vryheidsgrade en kan beweeg
Te veel beperkings wat bots; dit wys oranje
extra: The sketch has been padded into 3D
extraAf: Die skets is met Pad 3D gemaak
questions.explain: Fully constrained (green, zero DOF) is the goal for every sketch. Under-constrained can still shift; over-constrained has conflicting constraints (orange).
questions.explainAf: Volledig beperk (groen, nul DOF) is die doel vir elke skets. Onderbeperk kan nog skuif; oorbeperk het botsende beperkings (oranje).

questions.q: Match each constraint in column A with its effect in column B.
questions.qAf: Pas elke beperking in kolom A by sy effek in kolom B.
pairs: Two lines run in the same direction
Two points mirror each other around an axis
pairsAf: Twee lyne loop in dieselfde rigting
Twee punte is spieëlbeelde om 'n as

sections.title: Missing syntax
sections.intro: Type the missing symbol or word in each box.
sections.introAf: Tik die simbool of woord wat ontbreek in elke blokkie.

questions.q: Type the two symbols missing from this for loop.
questions.qAf: Tik die twee simbole wat in hierdie for-lus ontbreek.
questions.explain: Semicolons separate the three parts of a for loop.
questions.explainAf: Kommapunte skei die drie dele van 'n for-lus.

questions.q: Type the symbol that ends this statement.
questions.qAf: Tik die simbool wat hierdie stelling afsluit.

questions.q: Type the symbols that start each kind of comment.
questions.qAf: Tik die simbole waarmee elke soort kommentaar begin.
questions.fill:
Java:  [[]] draw the next side
HTML:  [[]] main menu -->
CSS:   [[]] page colours */
questions.fillAf:
Java:  [[]] teken die volgende sy
HTML:  [[]] hoofkieslys -->
CSS:   [[]] bladsykleure */
questions.explain: Java uses // for a single-line comment, HTML uses <!-- … -->, and CSS uses /* … */. Comments are not run or displayed.
questions.explainAf: Java gebruik // vir 'n eenreël-kommentaar, HTML gebruik <!-- … -->, en CSS gebruik /* … */. Kommentaar word nie uitgevoer of vertoon nie.

questions.q: Type the symbol missing from this closing tag.
questions.qAf: Tik die simbool wat in hierdie sluitetiket ontbreek.

questions.q: Type the symbol missing from this range.
questions.qAf: Tik die simbool wat in hierdie reeks ontbreek.

sections.title: Scenarios
sections.intro: Read each scenario, then answer the questions about it.
sections.introAf: Lees elke scenario en beantwoord dan die vrae daaroor.

questions.scenario: Zanele writes this code for her Gogga, ziggy.
questions.scenarioAf: Zanele skryf hierdie kode vir haar Gogga, ziggy.

questions.q: How many times does ziggy.move() run?
questions.qAf: Hoeveel keer word ziggy.move() uitgevoer?

questions.q: Which part of the loop is counter++?
questions.qAf: Watter deel van die lus is counter++?

questions.q: Why is counter an int?
questions.qAf: Hoekom is counter 'n int?

questions.q: ziggy.turnRight() runs 6 times.
questions.qAf: ziggy.turnRight() word 6 keer uitgevoer.
questions.explain: It is after the loop's closing }, so it runs once.
questions.explainAf: Dit is ná die lus se sluitende }, dus word dit een keer uitgevoer.

questions.scenario: A teacher has 25 learners' marks in C2:C26. Two learners were absent, so their cells are empty.
questions.scenarioAf: 'n Onderwyser het 25 leerders se punte in C2:C26. Twee leerders was afwesig, dus is hulle selle leeg.

questions.q: Which formula gives the class average?
questions.qAf: Watter formule gee die klasgemiddelde?

questions.q: Which formula finds the top mark?
questions.qAf: Watter formule vind die hoogste punt?

questions.q: What does =COUNT(C2:C26) give?
questions.qAf: Wat gee =COUNT(C2:C26)?
questions.explain: COUNT counts only cells with numbers: 25 − 2 = 23.
questions.explainAf: COUNT tel net selle met getalle: 25 − 2 = 23.

questions.scenario: Ayanda powers an LED from a 9 V battery. The LED drops 2 V, and she wants 10 mA (0.01 A).
questions.scenarioAf: Ayanda dryf 'n LED met 'n 9 V-battery aan. Die LED se spanningsval is 2 V, en sy wil 10 mA (0,01 A) hê.

questions.q: What voltage must the resistor take?
questions.qAf: Hoeveel spanning moet oor die resistor val?

questions.q: Which resistor does she need?
questions.qAf: Watter resistor het sy nodig?

questions.q: Why does the LED need a resistor?
questions.qAf: Hoekom het die LED 'n resistor nodig?
options: Its low internal resistance would let too much current flow
optionsAf: Sy lae interne weerstand sou te veel stroom laat vloei
questions.explain: The resistor in series limits the current.
questions.explainAf: Die resistor in serie beperk die stroom.
